interactions.name: petal_width_x_petal_length
interactions.rationale: Both top-correlated features (|r|>0.95); product sharpens class boundary near the petal plane.

interactions.name: petal_length_x_sepal_length
interactions.rationale: Moderate collinearity; interaction may separate class 1/2 boundary.

interactions.name: petal_width_x_sepal_length
interactions.rationale: Cross-organ interaction of top-1 and secondary correlated features.

ratio_features.name: petal_length_to_width_ratio
ratio_features.rationale: Petal aspect ratio is a compact species discriminator; epsilon avoids division by zero.

ratio_features.name: sepal_length_to_width_ratio
ratio_features.rationale: Sepal aspect ratio captures organ shape independent of scale.

summary_features.name: petal_length_minus_petal_width
summary_features.rationale: Petal dimension difference; adds linear combination not captured by direct features alone.

summary_features.name: sepal_length_minus_sepal_width
summary_features.rationale: Sepal dimension difference; complements sepal ratio feature with an additive signal.

feature_plan.rationale: Four direct numeric features cover all measured signals; petal features dominate (|r|>0.95). Interactions and ratios add non-linear separability for the class 1/2 boundary. No groups, no time, no text/images. All engineered groups flagged experimental (14 total features vs 120/10=12 threshold) for Step-6A ablation; no per-fold target leakage possible.

completeness_constraints.submission_frame_expansion: data/val.csv has 30 rows (from spec_parse.json file_schemas); submission maps 1:1 to those 30 rows identified by positional index (row_id_column is null); no period/group cross-join expansion required.
